entry_rule: Event known only at bar close; entry is NEXT_BAR_OPEN.
trade_selection: First valid event per swing per model.
sl: 1.0 x ATR14 at event bar, fixed at entry.
tp: 1.5 x ATR14 at event bar, fixed at entry.
intrabar_ambiguity: If SL and TP are both touched in the same M1 candle, SL is assumed first (conservative).
